facts.fact: Deliberation 004/2025 of the APD, adopted 14 July 2025 under article 73 of law 2017-020, sets the conditions, rules and procedures for transferring personal data abroad, with article 21 of the law having the APD publish and update a list of countries it judges adequate.

note: Passages file is cut after the preamble; it does not show the list of countries or any application procedure.
